anya.p (partnerships): Vendor asked for a joint marketplace handoff and coordinated announcement covering H100/H200/B200. They want one ops playbook that covers cross-GPU fallbacks. Tentative embargo week: June 10-16. Can we confirm feasibility?

mike.o (eng-ops): Quick ops note: H100 is green in dedicated; H200 still shows sporadic driver hangs on 535.22 in our stress lab. Marketplace cold starts will make p95 variable. We need a dry-run 48h before embargo and warm pools.

chris.t (product): Proposed rollout: stagger by device (H100 -> H200 -> B200), each with 12-24h canary. Rollback triggers: p99 latency >200ms or error rate >1% sustained 5m. Also require image naming policy: `redwood/<gpu>-prod:YYYYMMDD`.

sophia.mkt (marketing): Marketing needs final embargo date + partner PR contact. We need 10 business days for partner quote and 5 days for creative assets. Two windows okay: June 10 (tight) or June 24 (safer).

nate.s (solutions): SI checklist (short): driver floors, firmware floors, kernel min, quant builds, perf validation. I'll list exact driver/firmware pins once vendor confirms.

mike.o (eng-ops): Ops gating checklist draft: warm-pool >=15% projected early traffic, scanned images, smoke test (`k8s run --image=redwood/hw-smoke --replicas=10 --labels=marketplace-smoke`), canary autoscaler cap (+30%/10m), fallback routes preloaded (gaudi-lite, h100-softcap).

anya.p (partnerships): Vendor asked for 30-day onboarding SLA: 99.8% availability + 2hr incident response. Ops/product: realistic?

chris.t (product): 99.8% globally is tight but doable if warm pools + automatic fallback are in place. Estimate +15-20% infra cost for first month. Define availability scope (per-region vs global). Need a telemetry dashboard shared read-only with vendor for first 30 days.

sophia.mkt (marketing): I'll prepare partner quote template and shared assets folder. If we pick June 10, we need final assets by May 29.

mike.o (eng-ops): I'll owner ops playbook PR and runbook snippet. Draft failover steps: detect p99 spike, drain 30%, route 30% to fallback, scale warm pool + notify vendor SRE. I'll schedule marketplace dry-run (deploy-bot) 2026-05-20.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: scheduled dry run: `multi-gpu-marketplace-dryrun` on 4501280000 (2026-05-20T02:00:00Z).

anya.p (partnerships): Action items: nate -> SI checklist by Thu; mike -> ops playbook PR by Mon; chris -> finalize rollback policy & cost by Tue; sophia -> confirm embargo & partner PR contact by Fri. I'll send summary to vendor thread and request official dates. Please comment on PRs rather than here. :handshake:
